criteria.text: A series is created once as weekly on one or more chosen weekdays, with an optional start date and an optional end date; the creator never enters individual dates and no other pattern is offered
criteria.note: Built: `post_series` table and `page_posts.series_id` (migration 20261012040000), `group.post_create` takes a strict `series`, the composer's 'Repeat weekly' chips and bounds [V]. It is OFF in production: the control shows only with `NEXT_PUBLIC_SERIES_COMPOSER=1`, unset per the PR body [A, #753]. #753 is review-skipped; deploy-health green on 685f5d1. Checked: every marker says `partial` (wording, shape, bounds), and partial checks do not add up; no check claims all of it. Issue #592 closed; the check is filed as a new chore.

criteria.text: Every occurrence is a real page_posts row referencing its parent post, never a date computed at read time
criteria.note: Nothing writes occurrences: no occurrence rows, no maintenance job, no schedule; `page_posts.series_id` is the only hook and nothing writes a series after the first post [V grep src, scripts, .github, migrations]. Ticket #593.

criteria.text: Occurrences exist from today to three months ahead, at all times
criteria.note: No job keeps a window topped up: no occurrence rows, no maintenance job, no schedule; `page_posts.series_id` is the only hook and nothing writes a series after the first post [V grep src, scripts, .github, migrations]. Ticket #594.

criteria.text: The job that maintains that window is idempotent: running it twice creates nothing the first run did not
criteria.note: No job exists, and no uniqueness key on (series, start) [V]. Ticket #595.

criteria.text: An occurrence's start is computed in the metro's timezone, not by adding a fixed number of hours; a weekly series keeps its local time across a daylight-saving change
criteria.note: `metroWallTimeToInstant` is two-pass and DST-aware, but nothing expands occurrences; the metro carries no zone of its own yet (#173 open; a `markets.timezone` column exists and nothing reads it) [V]. Daylight saving ends 2026-11-01. Ticket #597.

criteria.text: A time-windowed read returns one row per series (its soonest occurrence in the window) and one row per non-recurring post
criteria.note: `browse_feed` has no distinct or grouping by series or parent [V migration 20261016150052]. Ticket #600; it must land with the expansion.

criteria.text: Editing one occurrence changes that occurrence and no other
criteria.note: `group.post_edit` updates one row in place, but no occurrence rows exist to prove it on [V]. Ticket #602.

criteria.text: Each occurrence behaves as its own dated post under F072: its own address, its own time-window match, its own responses
criteria.note: F072 gives a single post these; occurrence rows do not exist [V]. Ticket #603.
